phrases.reasoning: A name is written once and read everywhere, so the letters saved at the declaration are paid back at every call site by a reader who has to expand the abbreviation themselves and hope they expanded it the way the author meant.

millisecondSuffix.text: Identifier "{{name}}" should not abbreviate milliseconds as "Ms". Use "{{suggestion}}", which is how the rest of the tree spells a millisecond value: "durationInMilliseconds" outnumbers "durationMs" more than two to one for the identical value, so the rename follows what the codebase already decided rather than introducing a third spelling.
